reactor_type: over ﬂow design and a showerhead construction
evidence: Typical deposition temperatures for the H2O process lay between 200 and 350 /C14C. The ozone process can be used at temperatures between 200 and 450 /C14C. Exposure and purge times for the ALD cycle were chosen in typical regions, whereby purge times have been at least ﬁve time of the exposure time.
